problem_statement: POSIX requires that longjmp(buf, 0) causes setjmp() to return 1, not 0. The x86_64 and x86 sim assembly in libs/libc/machine/sim/arch_setjmp_x86_64.S and arch_setjmp_x86.S stores the longjmp val argument directly into eax/rax without the required zero-to-one substitution. Apps PR #2725 adds jump_with_retval() to testing/ostest/setjmp.c which calls longjmp(buf, 0) and then ASSERT(value == ret) where ret=1. On the base kernel, setjmp returns 0 so ASSERT fires (0 != 1) and ostest aborts before completing.
